packageRules.description: Every action here is already SHA-pinned, so a digest or patch bump only moves which commit the pin resolves to — the required checks are the review. A minor or major still waits for a human.
First-party references track the moving major tag by design; a digest pin here would defeat it.

This pin version-locks the vendored .specify/ and speckit skills, and only `mise run spec-kit-upgrade` re-syncs them — so the bump is half a change until a human runs it. Grouped alone, never with anything mergeable as-is.
prBodyNotes: :warning: Merging this alone leaves `.specify/integrations/*.manifest.json` describing a version nothing pins. Run `mise run spec-kit-upgrade` on this branch and commit the re-synced `.specify/` and `.claude/skills/speckit-*/` files first. Never `specify self upgrade` — it replaces the binary outside mise.
